messages:
Rina Kaur: Brain dump: dense grid on Console (lots of tiny inputs). We need a final call on required marker + validation UX. Prior constraints: vertical density, many collapsed groups, keyboard-first.
Marta Ruiz: Quick take: compact inline marker + top-level summary toast seems promising. Markers give field mapping without full helper visible.
Devin Chen: +1 but we must avoid layout shift1. Compact markers should not add height. 2. On submit, move focus to first invalid and open its group.
Ellie Wong: Accessibility checklist: always set aria-invalid on invalid fields and use aria-describedby to point at the full message (even if visually hidden). Use an aria-live region or role="alert" on the message when it becomes visible so SRs announce it after focus.
Rina Kaur: Good. For required marker: any preference between asterisk, small 'Required' postfix, or sr-only text? I worry asterisks are ambiguous for newcomers.
Marta Ruiz: Proposal: persistent tiny asterisk (saves space) + sr-only "Required" copy and a global legend. For discovery we can add a hover/focus tooltip.
Devin Chen: If we pick asterisk, ensure high contrast color tokens for dark/dim themes. Also add data-required="true" for automated tests.
Ellie Wong: Also propose variant B: tiny inline "Required" for the first field in each group then use legend for rest. This helps scanability for new users. We should usability-test both.
Rina Kaur: Validation summary toast: should include anchor links. Clicking one opens the accordion and focuses the field. Implementation note for devs: avoid setTimeout hacks. Ensure the error node exists before focus; use requestAnimationFrame or reveal synchronously.
Devin Chen: Example pseudo:
```js
openAccordion(parentId);
const field = document.getElementById('email');
field.focus();
// after reveal, ensure aria-describedby is present so SR announces
```
Ellie Wong: Instead of relying on timing, we can have the revealed error node set role="alert" when made visible, SRs will read it after focus. That avoids time-based race conditions.
Marta Ruiz: Destructive confirmation: typed-confirm only for irreversible data deletes (DB, audit logs). For single-item UI deletes use modal + undo toast. Copy rule: token = single lowercase word (no punctuation), show resource name + id.
Rina Kaur: Undo toast timing: propose 8s visible with action button and priority queue for toasts (error > undo > info). Only one toast visible. Lower-priority toasts queue.
Devin Chen: Also callout microcopy collision: autosave "Saved" toasts vs validation toasts. We should suppress benign info toasts while error toast is active.
Ellie Wong: QA focus: compact input focus ring >=3px and meets contrast in dim theme. Also test keyboard-only navigation with nested accordions and jump-from-toast behavior.
Marta Ruiz: Action items: I'll design 3 mocks: (1) asterisk + sr-only "Required" + summary toast with anchors; (2) first-field explicit "Required" + inline helpers; (3) no marker but inline terse labels with reveal-on-focus full helpers. Include ARIA annotations and a short test matrix.
design-bot: Filed: https://go.redwood/design/issues/CI-707 "Dense grid: required marker + validation routing + a11y matrix" Assigned to @Marta.
Rina Kaur: Timeline?
Marta Ruiz: Mock v1 by Tuesday EOD. Will post Figma link and small interactive prototype for keyboard tests.
Ellie Wong: I'll draft the SR test steps and contrast checklist.
Devin Chen: I'll add dev notes for openAccordion() + focus behavior and data-required attributes.
Rina Kaur: Thanks team. Short, testable decisions please. :thumbsup:
